KARL MAYER opens a new era in textile innovation 🚀. KARL MAYER officially inaugurated its new TEXTILE INNOVATION CENTER (TIC) in Obertshausen, Germany, bringing together warp knitting, technical textiles and warp preparation technologies under one roof. The 5,000 m² innovation hub is designed to accelerate textile development from idea to industrialization, offering advanced machinery, collaborative R&D opportunities and hands-on prototyping capabilities. Industry leaders including Karl Josef Mayer, Lutz Wolf and experts from New Balance Athletics highlighted the importance of connected textile innovation and future-oriented textile solutions during the event. title: Karl Mayer opens Textile Innovation Center
content: Karl Mayer will present the full capabilities of the Textile Innovation Center to customers, partners and the international trade press during its opening event week in Obertshausen from 21 to 24 April 2026, taking place in parallel with Techtextil Frankfurt. Karl Mayer is reinforcing its commitment to innovation with the opening of its new Textile Innovation Center (TIC) in Obertshausen. The facility reflects the company’s belief in the continuing value of textiles and aims to support customers and partners in developing high-performance fabrics and next-level textile solutions for a rapidly evolving market. The company views performance textiles as important drivers of growth for its customers and as potential game changers for the wider textile industry. It is designed to bring together brands, manufacturers and technology partners, enabling them to work directly with Karl Mayer specialists to explore new applications and constructions. Customers working in the TIC collaborate directly with Karl Mayer’s textile specialists, who bring decades of experience across markets ranging from fashion and sports textiles to highly specialised technical applications.
